name: Presell - Quien esta hablando V3
master_prompt: Spanish vertical UGC documentary filmed inside one real-estate office. The office is the main character and must always feel occupied and alive. One founder documents a single prospect named Mariana from first contact to apartment reservation. Build curiosity, confusion, discovery, escalation, awe, and desire only through pacing and visible consequences. One unexpected interruption only. Hard-cut-compatible independent leaves. No advertising performance, no SaaS demo, no motion graphics, no empty office, no fake smiles, and no cinematic polish.

hooks.title: Ochenta mil por el sistema
hooks.subject_label: same founder filming himself quietly in a busy real-estate office
hooks.subject_placement_hint: tight imperfect iPhone selfie, founder in black crewneck close to lens, real coworkers and glass office depth behind him, no text overlay
hooks.script: Un desarrollo nos pagó ochenta mil dólares por este sistema.
hooks.prompt: Immediate handheld iPhone selfie inside a warm premium real-estate office. The same young founder in a black crewneck speaks quietly to the phone while coworkers continue working behind glass, unaware of the camera. He is documenting, not pitching. A door at the edge of frame begins to move but nobody interrupts yet. Natural office sound, subtle focus breathing. Native dialogue exactly once: Un desarrollo nos pagó ochenta mil dólares por este sistema.

hooks.title: Quien esta hablando
hooks.subject_label: same founder caught filming when one confused coworker opens the office door
hooks.subject_placement_hint: same founder remains foreground; exactly one coworker opens the door, no third person near camera, one accidental interruption only
hooks.prompt: Same office and founder, continuous-feeling handheld shot. Exactly one male coworker opens the glass office door and leans in with genuine confusion while the founder freezes and glances toward him. Nobody performs for the camera. This is the only interruption in the entire video. No comedy mugging, no extra people entering, anatomically correct hands. Native dialogue from the coworker exactly once: ¿Quién está hablando solo?

mains.title: El sistema convierte un prospecto
mains.prompt: Follow only Mariana through one continuously operating commercial flow inside the same office.

segments.script: Entró Mariana: dos recámaras, presupuesto de cuatro punto dos millones.

Show the entire open MacBook and entire iPhone physically on the desk with keyboard, mouse, coffee, reflections, plants, and coworkers moving in background. A clean lead card uses only short readable fields: Mariana, 2 recámaras, $4.2M. No cropped device, no floating UI. He gives a restrained surprised breath, not a sales reaction. Keep desk edges, office reflections, coworkers, and full hardware visible. No floating text or extra hands. Native dialogue exactly once: Y mira esto: la unidad ochocientos cuatro cambió a apartado.
